title: Verify: Focus returns to the trigger unit tests
description: Unit tests that App returns focus to the trigger after Escape and Close.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Escape is pressed, then the trigger has focus
Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Close is clicked, then the trigger has focus
technical_constraints: Mock ../src/api/client getCurrentRound and listMine with vi.mock importOriginal as in tests/appRound.test.tsx; round data from roundFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts, mirroring the backend current-round response

steps.action: jsdom header; vi.mock the client with getCurrentRound resolving roundFixture and listMine resolving []. Render <App/>, click Begin, get the trigger by role button name 'Suggest What Happens Next', call trigger.focus() and click it. Test A: fireEvent.keyDown(getByRole('dialog'),{key:'Escape'}) then waitFor document.activeElement toBe trigger. Test B: click the Close button then waitFor the same assertion.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx
